assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause -- line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md line 19: 'The heading text is extracted using `line[3:]` -- this takes everything after `## ` but does NOT strip trailing whitespace.' Line 32: 'Divergence point: Step 3 above -- `line[3:]` does not call `.strip()` or `.rstrip()`, so trailing whitespace in the heading line is preserved in the dictionary key.'

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md: WHAT - lines 9-10: 'extracts CONVENTIONS.md section headings using `line[3:]`, which takes the text after `## ` but does not strip trailing whitespace'. WHERE - line 9: 'The plan-feature skill\'s convention conformance analysis' and lines 19-20: 'plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md -- convention conformance analysis section'. HOW TO VERIFY - lines 39-44: 'Create a test fixture CONVENTIONS.md with trailing whitespace on one or more section headings...
